case_name: Flower ad, scene 2 with a perfect reference: V3 case 3 against the MCP
title: Petal & Stem scene 2: the customer brings the bouquet home

turns.text: Second scene of the Petal & Stem ad, 16 seconds, widescreen: the customer in the attached frame (the woman with dark hair in a low bun and the cream jacket, holding the bouquet of yellow, magenta, cream and red flowers in pale paper) carries that same bouquet home and gives it to her partner, a man with short grey-flecked hair in a navy sweater, at their front door; he smiles and takes it; warm morning light; end on the two of them with the flowers. She, the bouquet and he must look the same throughout.

tests: The same woman as the frame (face, hair, jacket), the same bouquet, one consistent partner as described; the handoff at the door; warm morning light; 16 s 16:9.
must_haves: The woman is recognisably the person in the attached frame: dark hair in a low bun, cream jacket, same face.
The bouquet is the same one: yellow, magenta, cream and red flowers wrapped in pale paper, carried from the start.
Her partner is a man with short grey-flecked hair in a navy sweater, the same man throughout.
She hands him the bouquet at their front door and he takes it; it ends on the two of them with the flowers.
Warm morning light; about 16 seconds, widescreen 16:9.
